import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (boxplot)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with body type differentiation (scatter plot)
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, len(body_types)))

for body_type, color in zip(body_types, colors):
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body_type]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
                      alpha=0.6, s=50, color=color, label=body_type)

axes[0, 1].set_title('Megapixels vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Body Type', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Average price by brand (top 10 brands)
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(brand_price)), brand_price.values, color=plt.cm.Paired(np.arange(len(brand_price))))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Top 10 Brands by Average Price', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(brand_price)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(brand_price.index, rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add value labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
                   f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. 4K video capability distribution by body type (stacked bar)
video_by_body = pd.crosstab(df['body_type'], df['has_video_4k'], normalize='index') * 100
video_by_body.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 1], 
                   color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('4K Video Capability by Body Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(['No 4K Video', 'Has 4K Video'], title='4K Video', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
